documents.title: Announcement Under Regulation 30- SION Impact Update
Results- Financial Results For The Quarter Ended 30.06.2026
Board Meeting Intimation for Approving Inter-Alia The Un-Audited Financial Results (Standalone And Consolidated) Of The Company For The Quarter Ended 30Th June 2026.

analysis.summary: Nitta Gelatin India Limited reported a landmark financial year marked by its Golden Jubilee and the commissioning of a new Collagen Peptide Project with an installed capacity of 3.5 metric tonnes per day. Management noted that international trade uncertainty arose from United States tariff measures, but proactive diversification and customer-focused strategies helped maintain business stability. The company continues to progress its Gelatin Expansion Project as per schedule and remains focused on operational efficiency and risk management. Additionally, the Nitta Gelatin Group unveiled a Long-Term Management Vision targeting a doubling of net sales and a 2.5 times increase in operating income by March 2033.
